snippet.description:
Daniel Radcliffe didn’t just play Harry Potter—he cashed in big time. He started with $1 million for The Sorcerer’s Stone, jumped to $3 million for Chamber of Secrets, then pulled $6 million for Prisoner of Azkaban. Goblet of Fire got him $11 million, and Order of the Phoenix earned him $14 million. snippet.title: How Silver Surfer Was Made in 2007 – CGI or Real Suit?
snippet.description: Think the Silver Surfer in Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer was all CGI? Think again! 🌌 Doug Jones wore a real shiny gray suit and performed every scene on set — no green screen magic! Then came the twist: Laurence Fishburne, aka Morpheus from The Matrix, provided the voice. 🔥 Together, they created one of the coolest and most underrated Marvel characters ever. Did you know the Silver Surfer was played by two people? 🤯 #SilverSurfer #FantasticFour #DougJones #LaurenceFishburne #MarvelTrivia #BehindTheScenes #MovieMagic #MarvelMovies #UnderratedCharacters #RiseOfTheSilverSurfer #ComicBookMovies #SuperheroFacts #Marvel

snippet.title: Michael Chiklis Nearly BROKE in The Thing Suit on Set! 😰
snippet.description: Michael Chiklis was thrilled to play Ben Grimm/The Thing in Fantastic Four—but the iconic suit nearly broke him. 💥 The rock-like costume weighed over 30 pounds, took 4+ hours to apply, and felt like being stuck in a latex sauna. 😰 Claustrophobic, exhausting… and yet, Chiklis returned for the sequel. Now that’s superhero-level dedication. 💪🔥 #FantasticFour #TheThing #MichaelChiklis #MarvelMovies #BehindTheScenes #SuperheroStruggles #BenGrimm #MovieMakeup #LatexSuit #MarvelFacts #ComicBookMovies #FantasticFour2005 #MovieTrivia #SuperheroTransformation

snippet.title: The Most Underrated Harry Potter Character? Tonks Deserved Better! #harrypotter
snippet.description: Nymphadora Tonks deserved way more screen time in the Harry Potter films! 💫 Natalia Tena brought charm, strength, and unique energy to the role — yet the movies barely scratched the surface of her character. Did you know Tonks is a Metamorphmagus, able to change her appearance at will? Or that Natalia is also a musician? 🎶 A true Hufflepuff icon who left a lasting impression in such a short time.
